body.condition: For every \(1\le\ell\le H_n\) and every selectable direct layout, \(\bar z_{\mathrm{dir},n,\ell}\in\operatorname{col}(\bar Z_{\mathrm{dir},n})\).

novel.justification: This uniform selected-layout version of Shen's fixed-summary span condition is satisfied when each deterministic candidate Page block spans the same finite recurrence space, as for persistent harmonic, polynomial, and exponential factor sequences.
